text: 1) Undergraduate diploma and bachelor degree certificate and academic transcripts. (The notarized Chinese or English version must be provided if the originals are in other languages.)2) GMAT, GRE, TOEFL or IETLS and etc. certificate.3) Two recommendation letters. (The title of your referees should be associate professor or above.)4) Passport page and Chinese visa page (*if have).5) 1-inch digital bareheaded colorized photo.6) Passport page and Chinese Visa page (*if have).7) Self-drafted resume (in English).8) Study plan (in English).9) Non-Criminal Records with Chinese language translation and official notarization stamp from Chinese Embassy, or with the APOSTILLE verification. (In 6 months. If you have study or work experience in China, please provide both the record from both your home country and China.)10) Physical examination report.
